containers.text: BEFORE YOU START — a five-second check that the test data is there. Open global search and type ZZAUTOTEST. You should get several groups of results — Work orde

1. Open global search.
2. Type the vendor website: kestrelsupply-zzt.com
3. Read the Vendors group.
4. Clear the input and type the customer website: bridgeport
Step 2 returns the vendor 'ZZAUTOTEST Kestrel Parts Supply' under the Vendors group, and step 4 returns the customer 'ZZAUTOTEST Bridgeport Hauling' under the C
